scenes.title: A plan to *fake attacks*
scenes.say: In 1962, America's top military leaders proposed faking attacks on Americans, and blaming Cuba.

scenes.title: *Operation Northwoods*

label.name: JOINT CHIEFS OF STAFF
label.role: Memo to the Secretary of Defense

scenes.say: This is the real memo. The Joint Chiefs of Staff sent it to the Secretary of Defense. Its subject: justification for US military intervention in Cuba.

scenes.title: The *proposals*:
items: Blow up a US ship at *Guantanamo*
scenes.say: The ideas included blowing up a US ship at Guantanamo Bay and blaming Cuba, a fake Communist Cuban terror campaign in the Miami area, and faking the shootdown of a civilian airliner.

scenes.title: *L. L. Lemnitzer*
scenes.say: It was signed by the chairman of the Joint Chiefs, General Lyman Lemnitzer.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.say: Kennedy rejected the plan, and it was never carried out. The memo stayed secret until it was declassified in 1997. The plan was real. Confirmed.
